supersedes: direct profile ranking from role-specific scorecards without blocker audit

public_gates: M1784 must use only M1783 artifacts and must not rerun reset or rollout
M1784 must audit artifact completeness metric contract role admissibility ranking blockers and guardrails
M1784 must decide whether to route to role-slice localization metric/scenario repair branch synthesis or a tightly scoped comparison design

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1783 role-specific scorecards and blockers before deciding the next paper-route branch
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if scorecard artifacts are missing or inconsistent
stop if mitigation metric contract is violated
stop if ranking blockers are ignored or profile ranking is admitted without audit support
stop if the next route is ambiguous

route to metric or scenario repair if scorecard contracts are insufficient
route to branch synthesis if extraction and audit complete the scorecard branch without admitting ranking
route to tightly scoped comparison design only if audit explicitly admits a role-specific comparison surface

one follow-up manifest for localization repair synthesis or scoped comparison design
